title: SAIL-VOS: Semantic Amodal Instance Level Video Object Segmentation -- A Synthetic Dataset and Baselines
abstract: Source summary: SAIL-VOS is a GTA-V-derived synthetic video dataset. Its official README exposes RGB, modal instance-ID masks, and per-object amodal masks with consistent IDs across frames; the project page states non-commercial research/education use, no redistribution, and that users must own GTA V.
query: synthetic amodal video occlusion dataset SAIL-VOS open repository

title: SAIL-VOS 3D: A Synthetic Dataset and Baselines for Object Detection and 3D Mesh Reconstruction from Video Data
abstract: Source summary: SAIL-VOS 3D extends the earlier synthetic amodal video resource with frame-level mesh annotations, depth and object-centric 3D reconstruction targets. Its GTA-V terms must be checked before any use; it is a benchmark/reference rather than an unrestricted asset source.
query: synthetic amodal video occlusion dataset SAIL-VOS 3D

title: PointOdyssey: A Large-Scale Synthetic Dataset for Long-Term Point Tracking
abstract: Source summary: PointOdyssey v1.2 has 159 synthetic long videos and exposes RGB, depth, normals, modal instance segmentation, camera parameters, 2D/3D point trajectories and per-point visibility labels. The official code includes animal rendering, but the released dataset is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. It supervises points, not instance-level amodal masks or object identity recovery.
query: PointOdyssey dataset annotations occlusion visibility synthetic animal Blender

title: TAP-Vid: A Benchmark for Tracking Any Point in a Video
abstract: Source summary: the official reader supplies video, query/target points and a binary occlusion flag. Queries are either first-visible-point or strided; this establishes a clean causal visibility benchmark but carries no instance masks, amodal extent, individual identity, or distinction between physical full occlusion and out-of-frame disappearance.
query: TAP-Vid official GitHub visibility occlusion annotations

title: Occluded Video Instance Segmentation: A Benchmark
abstract: Source summary: OVIS has 296K modal instance masks for 5,223 instances in 25 categories and per-object coarse occlusion level (none/slight/severe). It is a real occluded VIS benchmark with animal categories, but it does not offer amodal masks or a verified ground-truth label for full physical occlusion recovery.
query: OVIS occluded video instance segmentation benchmark official annotations occlusion levels

title: MOSE: A New Dataset for Video Object Segmentation in Complex Scenes
abstract: Source summary: MOSE provides real VOS masks in complex, crowded scenes and explicitly highlights heavy occlusion and disappearance-reappearance. Its official pages report modal masks and object-level disappearance/reappearance rates, but do not establish amodal masks, occluder identity, or a ground-truth distinction between fully occluded and out-of-view states.
query: MOSE video object segmentation dataset occlusion reappearance masks

title: Tracking Any Object Amodally
abstract: Source summary: TAO-Amodal adds amodal boxes, visibility and uncertainty to TAO tracks, including fully invisible, out-of-frame and occluded objects across 880 categories. It retains modal masks but not amodal segmentation masks. AVA/HACS video access is gated and subject to non-commercial/no-redistribution conditions.
query: TAO-Amodal official dataset amodal bounding boxes fully invisible out-of-frame occluded

title: Track Anything Behind Everything: Zero-Shot Amodal Video Object Segmentation
abstract: Source summary: TABE releases TABE-51, visible-mask-prompted zero-shot amodal-video evaluation and generation code. The authors claim accurate amodal masks including complete occlusion; the pipeline requires SAM2, Stable Diffusion inpainting and CoCoCo, and the official README states at least 32GB VRAM. The exact construction and label scope should be read before using its claimed ground truth as a primary training target.
query: TABE-51 dataset official amodal video object segmentation full occlusion
